dedupe_keys.name: nepal telecommunications authority monthly telecommunication indicators mis reports 2003 to 2026

description: The Nepal Telecommunications Authority publishes a monthly Management Information System report of telecommunication indicators. The MIS page lists about 220 reports, from 2060 in the Nepali calendar (about 2003 to 2004) to Bhadra 2083 (August to September 2026), which is issue 212 of year XXII. Each report of about 13 pages covers voice telephony subscriptions by service, market shares by operator, population penetration of voice service, broadband internet subscriptions, market shares of data services by technology, mobile broadband market shares by operator, and broadband penetration, with further tables on other licensed services. The main operators are Nepal Telecom and Ncell, with internet service providers for fixed broadband. Coverage: Nepal, national totals by month, some by operator and technology. Format and access: PDF reports on the authority's website, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: PDF only, so tables must be extracted; months follow the Bikram Sambat calendar; early reports differ in layout; no provincial or district breakdown was seen. Simulation uses: a long monthly series of subscriptions and technology mix for Nepali telecom demand models, including recovery after the 2015 Gorkha earthquake. Related records: the ITU ICT statistics give comparable national series; the OpenCelliD database gives crowdsourced cell locations for Nepal.
licence: not stated (no licence or terms statement on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)
